basic_details.job_title: IICA Consultant- Assistant Hostel Warden Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs (IICA), Manesar, under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, is filling one post of Consultant- Assistant Hostel Warden in its Administration Department on a purely contractual basis, with a monthly consolidated pay of Rs. 40,000/- Rs. 50,000/-. Applicants need a Bachelor's degree in any discipline or a Diploma or certification in Hotel/Hostel Management, plus minimum 2 years of relevant experience, and must be below 63 years. CV and certificates go through a Google Form link, and the last date is 18 December 2026.

how_to_apply: Check that you meet the age, educational qualification and experience criteria, since a candidature is cancelled if the criteria are not met or incorrect or false information is furnished.
Submit your CV and certificates through the Google Form link given in the notice: https://forms.gle/13XwBnGnxXCbZPc16
Mention all qualifications and experience in the relevant field over and above the minimum prescribed, with complete, accurate and correct details.
Attach self-attested copies of the certificates listed below.
Do not send original certificates; they are to be produced at the presentation and/or interview.
Apply on or before 18.12.2026. Applications through any other mode are not accepted.
Matriculation or equivalent certificate in support of the declaration of age
Degree or Diploma Certificate or other certificate including mark-sheets in support of educational qualifications (mark-sheets alone in place of the Degree/Diploma/Certificate are not accepted)
If the qualification is equivalent, the authority (with number and date) under which it has been so treated

Certificate(s) from the Head(s) of Organization(s)/Department(s) for the entire experience claimed, showing the duration of employment (date, month and year), basic pay and consolidated pay as the case may be, and the nature of duties performed, issued on Letter Head and duly stamped by the Competent Authority
important_instructions: Applications received after the prescribed last date/time will not be entertained and will be summarily rejected. IICA is not responsible for non-receipt or delay in receipt of applications. The date of birth as recorded in the Matriculation, Higher Secondary Examination Certificate or an equivalent certificate only is accepted; no later request for change is considered. If copies of the required certificates are not received with the application, it is rejected and no appeal is entertained. A provisional claim regarding eligibility is not accepted. Candidates must not furnish false particulars or altered or tampered documents. Any inconsistency between documents must be explained. No TA/DA is permissible to attend the written/skill test and/or interview. No interim correspondence or personal enquiries are entertained, and IICA does not correspond about reasons for non-selection. Canvassing in any form disqualifies the candidate. Any dispute arising out of this recruitment is subject to the sole jurisdiction of the Courts in Haryana.

content_sections.heading: About IICA
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Corporate Affairs is an autonomous institution registered under the Societies Registration Act, 1860 by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs, Government of India. It works in the field of Corporate Affairs and offers courses and training programmes. Its campus at IMT Manesar, District Gurugram, spreads over 14 acres and has residential blocks and hostel facilities for staff and students.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Eligibility, educational qualifications, experience and age are all counted on the last date prescribed for submission of applications. The notice does not print any age relaxation. Mere possession of the essential qualifications does not entitle a candidate to be called for the presentation and/or interview. Candidates must be of sound health and, if selected, may have to undergo a medical examination if required. The notice says the Competent Authority may, in deserving cases, relax the prescribed eligibility criteria, including the emoluments, where deemed appropriate in the interest of the Institute. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions.

rows.requirement: Bachelor's degree in any discipline / Diploma or certification in Hotel/Hostel Management
Minimum 2 years relevant experience in institutions/ schools/ colleges or similar environments

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The selected candidate is paid a monthly consolidated pay of Rs. 40,000/- Rs. 50,000/-. The notice states that no other allowances or benefits are admissible, namely Dearness Allowance, Transport Allowance, House Rent Allowance, Leave Travel Concession (LTC), medical facilities and other compensation packages. Leave is granted as per the policy of the Institute. The mode of recruitment is contractual, extendable based on performance and project requirements. The notice reserves the Institute's right to offer the selected candidate a lower fee/position as deemed appropriate within the same School/Centre.

content_sections.heading: IICA Consultant- Assistant Hostel Warden Job Description
content_sections.text: Supervising hostel operations, cafeteria operations, and administration Ensure discipline, safety, and security of hostel residents Address student concerns and grievances in a timely and empathetic manner Coordinate with housekeeping, security, and maintenance staff Maintain hostel records, reports and registers Assist in organizing hostel activities and student engagement programs Oversee daily functioning of the mess/canteen, ensure timely preparation and serving of meals, monitor quality and hygiene of food Inspect kitchen, dining areas, and storage facilities Ensure proper handling and storage of food items Ensure cleanliness, hygiene, and proper upkeep of hostel premises Basic computer skills (MS Word, Excel, email communication) Knowledge of hostel rules, safety norms, and basic first aid Shall be responsible for cleanliness and activities related to mess and housekeeping Shall monitor campus horticulture and security arrangements Any other task as assigned by the Reporting Officer Shall be required to stay in the Campus 6 days a week

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: All applications received up to the due date/time are screened against the minimum educational qualification and experience criteria. Only shortlisted candidates are called for a presentation and/or interview before the duly constituted selection committee. The date and time will be communicated separately. The interview is to be held at IICA Campus, Manesar or through video conference. IICA reserves the right to devise its own criteria for shortlisting, and the Selection Committee shortlists candidates adopting such criteria. The Institute's decision on eligibility, acceptance or rejection of applications, equivalence of qualifications, and the mode of screening and selection is final and binding. The institute communicates only with shortlisted candidates.
